channel.title: Render incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Render's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Some Web services in Oregon unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Some web services in Oregon were unavailable between 19:20 and 19:30 UTC.

item.title: Degraded dashboard performance [resolved]
item.description: We've continued to observe no further issues and deploy failure reasons have been re-enabled.

item.title: Service Disruption in Oregon [resolved]
item.description: This incident has now been resolved.

item.title: Degraded builds/deploys (all regions) [resolved]
item.description: Builds failure rates have recovered. Resolving.

item.title: GitHub outage affecting new service creation and service deploys [resolved]
Some users enrolled in 2FA are experiencing login issues [resolved]
Some services and datastores in Singapore experiencing brief disruptions [resolved]
Delayed wildcard issuance or renewal [resolved]
item.description: Issuance has returned to expected performance and we've observed no further impact.

item.title: External connections to Postgres services may terminate intermittently [resolved]
item.description: This has now been resolved. Customers will have seen an impact from Jun 22, 2026, at 11:50 UTC.

item.title: Slow/failing wildcard certificates related to LetsEncrypt incident [resolved]
item.description: We have observed no further impact from the upstream LetsEncrypt issue over the last 4 hours. All Render systems are fully operational.

item.title: Stuck queued deploys [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. If you still have a stuck queued deploy, follow the instructions below under "Investigating" to clear the queue. It should then work again as expected going forward.

item.title: Emails, including notifications, are delayed [resolved]
item.description: Outstanding emails have been sent and processing has returned to expected operation.

item.title: Unable to load metrics for some services in Oregon [resolved]
Upstream provider outage causing delays provisioning custom domains [resolved]
item.description: Our upstream provider has resolved the issue and custom domain provisioning has recovered.

item.title: Investigating Intermittent Postgres Connectivity Issues in the Oregon Region [resolved]
Logs unavailable for some services in all regions [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 19:45 UTC and 20:30 UTC, logs may be unavailable in the Dashboard. For logs that are unavailable, logs were not streamed to third-party logging providers.

item.title: Certificate issuance paused for Let's Encrypt [resolved]
item.description: Let's Encrypt has resumed certificate issuance.

item.title: HA Postgres Unavailability [resolved]
item.description: Everything is back to normal, and the incident is now resolved. We are planning long-term mitigations to prevent this issue from recurring, and we will share the results of our investigation with all affected customers.

item.title: Delayed deployment for new services in Oregon region [resolved]
